context.description: A short backlog. Sync is opt-in via scenario-meta.syncTarget; here it is 'github' (skills/sync-task/sync-task-github/ is installed, Start/End/Actual Time board fields mapped).
context.note: On pickup a task is set in_progress and stamped startedAt; at close-out/failure it is stamped finishedAt and synced once. The runner never writes code. syncTarget unset = sync skipped.

evals.title: Pickup stamps time but does not sync
evals.prompt: 01-add-item-test is picked. Handle pre-flight and pickup.
expectations: status set to in_progress and startedAt stamped (ISO 8601)
the task is NOT synced at pickup — sync-task-github is not run here
the rule followed is one sync per task at close-out, not one per status transition

evals.title: Close-out syncs the one task once
evals.prompt: The engineer returns 01-add-item-test red, which matches its acceptance. Close it out.
expectations: status set to done and finishedAt stamped
sync-task-github's engine is run on that one task's JSON only (single-task sync), carrying its final status + startedAt / finishedAt / actual time
the whole topic is NOT re-synced — only this one card is updated
this is the task's single sync; pickup did not sync it

evals.title: No syncTarget: stamp but skip sync
evals.prompt: Run the same close-out, but scenario-meta has no syncTarget set.
expectations: status / startedAt / finishedAt are still written to the task file
no sync runs at all — sync is opt-in and skipped when syncTarget is unset
the loop proceeds normally and does not treat the missing sync as an error
